rootCause: resolveLdtRoot() in railManifestDerivation.ts defaulted to process.cwd(). R2 countyRailRefreshCli --apply was invoked from artifacts/api-server (or equivalent subdirectory cwd), so ldtScorerPath probes resolved to artifacts/api-server/artifacts/api-server/src/*.ts and returned hasWriter=false for geometry, zoning, and envelope despite scorer files and atom data being intact. county_rail.has_writer=false then dominated displayState via countyLedger.ts CASE precedence, blanking 762 cells (3 rails x 254 counties) while county_facet_coverage scores remained.
evidence: Repro: node existsSync probe from cwd=artifacts/api-server returns false for countyGeometryScoreCli.ts (double artifacts path); from repo root returns true. Dry-run refresh post-fix showed geometry/zoning/envelope hasWriter false->true. Live GET /api/county-ledger twice 3s apart after --apply: satisfiedCells 309 both reads; geometry satisfied-present 194 + not-yet 60; zoning satisfied-present 1 + not-yet 253; flood satisfied-present 114 + not-yet 140 unchanged. Atoms store SQL (hauska DATABASE_URL): parcel-node 11603489 rows / 195 counties; flood-hazard-fact 2489336 rows / 180 counties.
